ValidationRule.description: Requires that the opp has at least one product and a nonzero Amount. Initial opps have this requirement past the Discovery stage. Subsequent opps have this requirement anytime the opp is edited.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( of_Opportunity_Products__c = 0, ISBLANK(Amount), Amount < 0 ) && OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Initial_Opportunity" && ISCHANGED(StageName) && OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Discovery"), ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Validation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Negotiation"), ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Verbal Commit"), ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Won"), ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Lost") ), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Expansion_Upsell", NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(StageName), IsClosed ) ) && NOT( AND( TEXT(PRIORVALUE(StageName)) = "Prospecting", ISPICKVAL(StageName,"Closed Lost") ) ) && !ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please make sure this opportunity has at least one opportunity product.
